atoms.title: CIA triad: confidentiality, integrity, availability
atoms.objective: Name and define each pillar of the CIA triad, give a concrete example and a countermeasure for each, and explain how the three pillars can come into conflict.

atoms.title: Threat actors and their motivations
atoms.objective: Identify the six major threat actor categories, explain what motivates each one, and use motivation to recommend the most appropriate defensive measure for a given attack scenario.

atoms.title: Risk language: likelihood, impact, and security goals
atoms.objective: Define likelihood, impact, and asset value in a cybersecurity context, calculate a risk score, and select and justify the most appropriate risk treatment (Mitigate, Accept, Transfer, Avoid) for a given scenario.
